change: Use a board-rate causal filter of encoder-delayed target velocity for damping feedforward compensation

proposed_by.agent: Codex (Trajectory Tracking Agent filter history lane)

name: P5.s.pass3.filter-history
summary: Predict board damping lag from the delayed and filtered target velocity history.
description: Replace the constant velocity lag times acceleration with the board-rate filter of the encoder-delayed target history. Preserve the fitted model, gains, reference tape and per-joint midpoint timing.
expect: Reach dev tool_track_rms_mm < 0.03100 mm versus 0.031333594888818476 mm for p5s-pass3 with all five gates passing on all 42 dev tasks. The filtered target should improve compensation around acceleration changes.
